audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer sides read Xerath/Xerath/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill while the content layer and the packet levelChart both read Xerath/Xerath/Xerath/Xerath/Xerath/Azir/Azir — five rows rendering two answers.
audit.why: 44.32% over 837 games, and the kit backs the content layer: Arcanopulse 750, Eye of Destruction 1000, Shocking Orb 1050 all out-range Azir's 525 soldier until Nashor's Tooth lands.
audit.corrected: phases[2..4].side moved to Xerath and phases[5..6].side to Azir so both layers match; whys rewritten to match each new verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was described as his peak without saying why it is also his vulnerability.
audit.why: enemyKit R: 'Xerath immobilizes himself and gains numerous long-range barrages' — channel flag, 'interruptible — any CC cancels it', 130/115/100s. He cannot move during it and Emperor's Divide knocks back.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now names the channel as the punish window; carry and ahead point Emperor's Divide at a stationary Xerath.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly called Eye of Destruction the 'E stun'. Eye of Destruction is his W (1000-range barrage, slow); the stun is Shocking Orb (E), 1050 range, 13/12.5/12/11.5/11s. Also unstated: Arcanopulse, Shocking Orb and Rite of the Arcane are ALL projectiles, so the minion wave eats them.
audit.why: enemyKit slots and flags are unambiguous. packet.suspectNames flagged wants.foe[1] for exactly this.
audit.corrected: Shocking Orb named as the stun in spikes[0], wants.foe[1] and early; the projectile/minion-block interaction now stated in dosFull[1].d and early.

audit.why: It is the field that exists to hold cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Shocking Orb 13s, Arcanopulse 9s, Eye of Destruction 14s, Azir E 22s stated at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim under unrelated titles (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED); dosFull[0].d and dontsFull[0].d did not match their titles either.

edits.before: E completes the safety net — you now have the shield-dash out. Greedier soldier placements are allowed, not encouraged.
edits.after: Shocking Orb stuns from 1050 and Arcanopulse reaches 750 — both out-range your 525 soldier. E is an escape here, not an entry.

edits.before: Nashor's components arrive and the soldier DPS starts to sting. Drag Qs through Xerath on every last-hit he takes.
edits.after: His mana items land and Eye of Destruction chips you from 1000 range every wave. Farm behind the caster minions.

edits.before: Emperor's Divide online — the dive insurance and the insec flip. With R up you win every 2v2 your jungler joins.
edits.after: Rite of the Arcane roots him in place for the channel — his peak window, and the one moment you can punish him for it.

edits.before: Nashor's spike: your soldier poke becomes shred. Shove crashes and rotate — the soldiers siege towers better than any mid.
edits.after: Nashor's lands and soldier DPS beats artillery chip. Crash waves and force him to answer you at 525 instead of 1050.

edits.before: Full build Azir is a teamfight: R cuts the fight in half, soldiers melt whoever is on your side of the wall.
edits.after: Full build you close the gap: E to a forward soldier, and Emperor's Divide cuts a stationary Xerath off from his team.

edits.before: Xerath wins by landing Shocking Orb (Stun), denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Xerath wins by landing Shocking Orb from 1050, then following with Arcanopulse and Eye of Destruction before your E is back.

edits.before: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — His only CC — dodge the orb and his artillery never converts into a kill. It governs your forward steps. - E Shifting Sands spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Shocking Orb is 13s at rank 1 and his only CC: bait it and you get 13 seconds of free steps. - Arcanopulse is 9s and Eye of Destruction 14s — poke in those gaps. - E Shifting Sands on poke is a 22-second death you scheduled. - Hold R for the fight that decides.

edits.before: His only CC — dodge the orb and his artillery never converts into a kill. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Place the soldier past him, Q it back through his body as he steps up for a minion, then step out of Arcanopulse's 750 line.

edits.before: W behind the wave, Q-drag the soldier through Xerath on his last-hit, auto once through the soldier, step back — two-second trades he cannot answer without overextending.
edits.after: Arcanopulse reaches 750 and Shocking Orb 1050, but both are projectiles the minion wave eats. Keep the caster line between you and let the soldier deal the damage.

edits.before: Xerath burns Shocking Orb (Stun) on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Shocking Orb whiffs and you have a full 13 seconds where he cannot stop you.

edits.before: That is Xerath’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Whiffed sand costs 40 mana and leaves you nothing to E to when the orb does land.

edits.before: Standing at max soldier range admiring your poke with E on cooldown — that is the engage window every Xerath player is waiting for.
edits.after: Rite of the Arcane reaches 5000 units and Shocking Orb stuns at 1050 — shoving past river unwarded is how that pair finds you.

edits.before: Ahead, siege: crash waves with soldier autos, take every plate, and rotate to river with R held — your wall converts even fights into massacres.
edits.after: Ahead, siege: crash with soldier autos, take plates while Shocking Orb's 13 seconds is down, and rotate with R held to cut him off his team.

edits.before: Carry through siege control — soldiers take plates, R denies engages, and your DPS curve outlasts every assassin spike in the lobby.
edits.after: Carry through siege — soldiers take plates, and Emperor's Divide cuts a stationary Xerath off from his team mid-channel.

edits.before: If Xerath gets a kill, the lane gets honest — give Shocking Orb (Stun) extra room and farm it back. Two kills: stop dueling your tilt — farm at soldier range and stay relevant through wave control.
edits.after: If Xerath gets a kill the lane gets honest — give Shocking Orb's 1050 range extra room and farm it back behind the caster line. Two kills: farm at soldier range and stay relevant through wave control.

edits.before: Xerath's Arcanopulse (Q) and Eye of Destruction (E) stun outrange your soldiers significantly, letting him poke you down safely from beyond your engage threat all through early levels.
edits.after: Xerath's Arcanopulse (Q) at 750 and Shocking Orb (E) stun at 1050 outrange your 525 soldiers, letting him poke you down safely from beyond your engage threat all through the early levels.

edits.before: Land Eye of Destruction (E) stun into a follow-up combo for a lane kill
edits.after: Land his Shocking Orb (E) stun into a follow-up combo for a lane kill

edits.before: Xerath is one of the most oppressive ranged poke matchups you'll face — his Arcanopulse and Eye of Destruction both outrange your soldiers, so he can chip your health bar every wave with almost no risk of retaliation. Play patient, use minions to block skillshots, and avoid overextending since his E stun into full combo can delete a chunk of your health from a distance you can't punish.
edits.after: Xerath is one of the most oppressive ranged poke matchups you'll face — Arcanopulse reaches 750 and Shocking Orb 1050 against your 525 soldier, so he chips your health bar every wave with almost no risk of retaliation. Play patient, keep minions between you since both are projectiles, and avoid overextending: Shocking Orb on 13 seconds into his full combo takes a chunk of your health from a distance you can't punish.
